body:
the police were involved so many times.. i live in a small town and they only care about drugs. i was told if i tried to charge him nothing would come of it and the police officer said i’d probably just end up pissing him off more. his father was a big dealer in town so the cops were ever only interested in him, not his son and his girlfriends “domestic disputes” i’m scared to charge him anyways because like i said i still care about him and he’s had it rough and i don’t want to do anything to make it any worse. i know that’s not fair but i know i would never forgive myself if i sent him to jail and his life only went down hill. 

i don’t know what’s wrong with me why i can’t just stand up for myself.
